sections.title: Background
paragraphs: The zorbel margin is not visible in the Vell phase.  Readers  disagree on its edge.
Café notation and café notation are equivalent here — a synthetic check.

sections.title: Results
paragraphs: Quintar outlines were revised in 12 of 40 synthetic cases. The revision rate was not reduced by training. Outlines were then re-read.

sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: Automated quintar tracing produced false regions near the flux duct. Human review removed most of them. Some remained after review.

sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: This invented record reports a zorbel result that was later withdrawn.
